blocks.zh: 風險評估、風險控制、整體殘餘風險、審查與上市後活動
blocks.en: Risk Evaluation, Risk Control, Overall Residual Risk, Review and Post-Production Activities

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: Understand how estimated risk is compared against acceptability criteria and what happens when criteria are not met — 了解如何將估計風險與可接受標準比較，以及不符合標準時的處置方式
blocks.en: Understand how estimated risk is compared against acceptability criteria and what happens when criteria are not met

blocks.zh: Apply the three-tier risk control hierarchy (inherently safe design → protective measures → information for safety) — 應用三層次風險控制優先順序
blocks.en: Apply the three-tier risk control hierarchy (inherently safe design → protective measures → information for safety)

blocks.zh: Distinguish between individual residual risk evaluation and overall residual risk evaluation — 區分個別殘餘風險與整體殘餘風險的評估
blocks.en: Distinguish between individual residual risk evaluation and overall residual risk evaluation

blocks.zh: Understand when and why a risk management review must be triggered — 了解風險管理審查的觸發時機與原因
blocks.en: Understand when and why a risk management review must be triggered

blocks.zh: Identify the data sources and feedback mechanisms for post-production risk monitoring — 識別上市後風險監控的資料來源與回饋機制
blocks.en: Identify the data sources and feedback mechanisms for post-production risk monitoring

blocks.zh: 第6節 — 風險評估：核心概念
blocks.en: Clause 6 - Risk Evaluation: Core Concepts

blocks.zh: 兩種結果，二選一
blocks.en: Two Outcomes, Pick One

blocks.zh: 風險評估只有兩種結果：
blocks.en: Risk evaluation has only two possible outcomes:

blocks.zh: 可接受（Acceptable）：記錄結論，繼續下一步。
blocks.en: Acceptable: Document the conclusion and move on to the next step.

blocks.zh: 不可接受（Unacceptable）：必須進入第7節的風險控制流程，不能停在這裡。
blocks.en: Unacceptable: The risk must go into the risk control process of Clause 7; you cannot stop here.

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則：標準必須在看到結果前就先設定
blocks.en: Key principle: set the criteria before you see the results

blocks.zh: 可接受性標準（acceptability criteria）必須在風險評估之前就已寫入風險管理計畫，不能在看到風險估計值之後才「回頭定義」什麼叫可接受。這是法規稽查的常見查核點。
blocks.en: The acceptability criteria must be written into the risk management plan before risk evaluation. You cannot define "acceptable" retroactively after seeing the risk estimates. This is a common audit checkpoint for regulators.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務情境
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Scenario

blocks.zh: 當供應商通知原料規格變更（material change），你需要重新估計新原料的風險，然後對照風險管理計畫中已定義的標準進行評估。若超出標準，必須啟動風險控制，不能以「歷史上沒問題」為由接受。
blocks.en: When a supplier notifies you of a raw material specification change (material change), you need to re-estimate the risk of the new material and evaluate it against the criteria already defined in the risk management plan. If it exceeds the criteria, risk control must be initiated; you cannot accept it on the grounds that "there has never been a problem historically."

blocks.zh: 第7節 — 風險控制：三層次優先序
blocks.en: Clause 7 - Risk Control: Three-Tier Order of Priority

blocks.zh: 三層次優先順序（降序排列）
blocks.en: Three-tier order of priority (in descending order)

blocks.zh:
第一優先：設計本質安全（Inherently Safe Design）
消除或減少危害本身——從根本解決問題。例：將銳角設計為圓角；改用手動幫浦取代電動幫浦。
blocks.en:
First priority: Inherently Safe Design
Eliminate or reduce the hazard itself, solving the problem at its root. Examples: change sharp corners to rounded corners; use a manual pump instead of an electric pump.

blocks.zh:
第二優先：防護措施（Protective Measures）
防止危險情境發生，或防止危險情境導致傷害。例：安全閥、自動斷電、IPC 檢測、EM 監控。
blocks.en:
Second priority: Protective Measures
Prevent the hazardous situation from occurring, or prevent the hazardous situation from leading to harm. Examples: safety valves, automatic power cut-off, IPC testing, EM monitoring.

blocks.zh:
第三優先：安全資訊（Information for Safety）
標籤警語、使用說明書（IFU）、操作培訓。
blocks.en:
Third priority: Information for Safety
Labeling warnings, instructions for use (IFU), operator training.

blocks.zh: 黃金法則：不能只靠標籤
blocks.en: Golden rule: labeling alone is not enough

blocks.zh: 標籤（labeling）是最後手段，不是第一選擇。若一個風險可以透過設計消除，就不能用貼警語來替代。法規稽查員會特別審查：「你為何沒有在設計層面控制這個風險，而僅依賴標籤？」
blocks.en: Labeling is the last resort, not the first choice. If a risk can be eliminated through design, a printed warning cannot be used as a substitute. Regulatory inspectors will specifically ask: "Why did you not control this risk at the design level and instead rely only on labeling?"

blocks.zh: CDMO 製造場景：防護措施的典型例子
blocks.en: CDMO manufacturing scenario: a typical example of protective measures

blocks.zh: 無菌填充工廠的大多數過程控制（IPC、環境監測、滅菌驗證）屬於防護措施（第二層）。它們降低傷害發生的機率，但並未消除危害本身（微生物仍然存在於環境中）。
blocks.en: Most process controls in an aseptic filling facility (IPC, environmental monitoring, sterilization validation) are protective measures (tier 2). They reduce the probability of harm but do not eliminate the hazard itself (microorganisms are still present in the environment).

blocks.zh: 若要達到「設計本質安全（第一層）」，則需要徹底重新設計——例如改用隔離器（isolator）技術，將操作人員完全隔離在無菌空間之外。
blocks.en: Achieving "inherently safe design (tier 1)" would require a fundamental redesign, for example moving to isolator technology so that operators are completely separated from the sterile space.

blocks.zh: 7.2 實施驗證 vs. 效果驗證
blocks.en: 7.2 Verification of Implementation vs. Verification of Effectiveness

blocks.zh: ISO 14971 要求兩種截然不同的驗證：
blocks.en: ISO 14971 requires two distinctly different kinds of verification:

blocks.zh: 實施驗證（Verification of Implementation）：這個措施有沒有被正確落實？（查設計文件或製程規格）
blocks.en: Verification of Implementation: Has the measure been implemented correctly? (Check design documents or process specifications.)

blocks.zh: 效果驗證（Verification of Effectiveness）：這個措施有沒有達到預期的風險降低效果？（可能需要測試、臨床研究或可用性測試）
blocks.en: Verification of Effectiveness: Has the measure achieved the intended risk reduction? (This may require testing, clinical studies or usability testing.)

blocks.zh: 兩者都必須有文件記錄，缺一不可。
blocks.en: Both must be documented; neither can be omitted.

blocks.zh: 7.3 殘餘風險評估：用同一把尺量
blocks.en: 7.3 Residual Risk Evaluation: Use the Same Yardstick

blocks.zh: 風險控制實施後，剩下的殘餘風險要用與最初風險評估相同的標準和方法再評估一次。這不是重新打分，是再次對照同一把尺——若仍不可接受，必須繼續尋找可行的控制措施，或進行效益-風險分析。
blocks.en: After risk controls are implemented, the remaining residual risk must be evaluated again using the same criteria and methods as the initial risk evaluation. This is not re-scoring; it is measuring against the same yardstick again. If the risk is still unacceptable, you must keep looking for feasible control measures or perform a benefit-risk analysis.

blocks.zh: 7.4 效益-風險分析：最後的防線
blocks.en: 7.4 Benefit-Risk Analysis: The Last Line of Defense

blocks.zh: 效益-風險分析只有在「進一步風險控制不可行」時才能使用，且不能用來掩護商業決策。
blocks.en: Benefit-risk analysis may be used only when "further risk control is not practicable," and it must not be used to cover for a commercial decision.

blocks.zh: 效益評估的四個維度：
blocks.en: Four dimensions for evaluating benefit:

blocks.zh: 效益的類型（救命性 vs. 診斷輔助）
blocks.en: The type of benefit (life-saving vs. diagnostic aid)

blocks.zh: 效益的幅度（改善程度有多大）
blocks.en: The magnitude of benefit (how large the improvement is)

blocks.zh: 患者實際獲得效益的機率
blocks.en: The probability that the patient actually obtains the benefit

blocks.zh: 效益的持續時間
blocks.en: The duration of the benefit

blocks.zh: 7.5 警覺：控制措施可能引入新風險
blocks.en: 7.5 Watch Out: Control Measures Can Introduce New Risks

blocks.zh: 新增一個風險控制措施可能會降低某個風險，但同時引入新的風險，或使原本可接受的風險變得不可接受。每次新增控制措施後，必須重新評估整體風險狀況。這在軟體設計中尤為常見——修一個 bug 可能破壞另一個安全機制。
blocks.en: Adding a risk control measure may reduce one risk while introducing a new risk, or may make a previously acceptable risk unacceptable. After each new control measure is added, the overall risk picture must be re-evaluated. This is especially common in software design, where fixing one bug may break another safety mechanism.

blocks.zh: 記憶口訣：ABC 三層控制
blocks.en: Memory aid: ABC, the three control tiers

blocks.zh: A — 設計（Architecture）：從根本消除危害
blocks.en: A - Architecture (design): Eliminate the hazard at its root

blocks.zh: B — 屏障（Barrier）：防護措施，阻止危害成真
blocks.en: B - Barrier: Protective measures that stop the hazard from materializing

blocks.zh: C — 溝通（Communication）：安全資訊，最後防線
blocks.en: C - Communication: Information for safety, the last line of defense

blocks.zh: 先 A 再 B 再 C，不能跳過前面直接到 C。
blocks.en: A first, then B, then C; do not skip the earlier tiers and go straight to C.

blocks.zh: 第8節 — 整體殘餘風險評估
blocks.en: Clause 8 - Evaluation of Overall Residual Risk

blocks.zh: 個別可接受 ≠ 整體可接受
blocks.en: Individually acceptable ≠ overall acceptable

blocks.zh: 這是 Section 8 最重要的核心概念：每一個單獨的殘餘風險都通過了評估，不代表所有風險加總後的整體殘餘風險也是可接受的。
blocks.en: This is the most important core concept of Clause 8: the fact that every individual residual risk has passed evaluation does not mean that the overall residual risk of all risks combined is also acceptable.

blocks.zh: 類比：一棟大樓裡每個房間的消防設備都合格，但若走道設計有問題導致整棟樓疏散動線混亂，整體安全仍然不足。
blocks.en: Analogy: the fire-fighting equipment in every room of a building is up to standard, but if a problem in the corridor design makes the evacuation routes of the whole building confusing, overall safety is still inadequate.

blocks.zh: 為什麼不能直接數字加總？
blocks.en: Why can't the risks simply be added up numerically?

blocks.zh: 每個危害情境對應不同的嚴重度（severity）與發生機率，不在同一基準上。
blocks.en: Each hazardous situation has a different severity and probability of occurrence, so they are not on the same basis.

blocks.zh: 機率的不確定程度各不相同（軟體失效的機率往往無法精確估計）。
blocks.en: The degree of uncertainty in the probabilities differs (the probability of software failure often cannot be estimated precisely).

blocks.zh: 在風險分析常用的寬泛分類下，各傷害的嚴重度無法合併計算。
blocks.en: Under the broad categories commonly used in risk analysis, the severities of different harms cannot be combined.

blocks.zh: ISO 10993-1 的銜接
blocks.en: Link to ISO 10993-1

blocks.zh: 對於涉及材料與生物相容性的風險，ISO 10993-1 的生物學評估報告（Biological Evaluation Report, BER）是整體殘餘風險評估的重要輸入文件。BER 提供材料相關殘餘風險的量化或定性結論，整合進第8節的整體評估。
blocks.en: For risks involving materials and biocompatibility, the Biological Evaluation Report (BER) under ISO 10993-1 is an important input to the overall residual risk evaluation. The BER provides quantitative or qualitative conclusions on material-related residual risks, which are integrated into the overall evaluation in Clause 8.

blocks.zh: 整體評估的四種方法工具
blocks.en: Four methods and tools for the overall evaluation

blocks.zh: 效益加權法：以整體效益對照整體殘餘風險——最常用的敘述性方法。
blocks.en: Benefit weighting method: Compare the overall benefit against the overall residual risk; the most commonly used narrative method.

blocks.zh: 視覺化矩陣法：將所有殘餘風險標繪於風險矩陣中，觀察整體分佈。
blocks.en: Visual matrix method: Plot all residual risks on a risk matrix and observe the overall distribution.

blocks.zh: 對標類似器材法：與市場上類似器材的上市後投訴、不良事件資料比較。
blocks.en: Benchmarking against similar devices: Compare with post-market complaints and adverse event data for similar devices on the market.

blocks.zh: 專家審查法：跨學科專家團隊（含臨床專家）進行獨立評估。
blocks.en: Expert review method: An independent evaluation by a multidisciplinary team of experts (including clinical experts).

blocks.zh: 過多警語的悖論
blocks.en: The paradox of too many warnings

blocks.zh: 8.2(d) 提出一個微妙但重要的觀點：若在個別風險控制中大量使用警語，每個警語單獨看都有效，但警語太多反而會讓使用者感到困惑、降低每一條警語的實際效果，進而提高整體殘餘風險。這呼應了 7.6 節的「過度依賴標籤」問題。
blocks.en: 8.2(d) raises a subtle but important point: if warnings are used extensively in individual risk controls, each warning may look effective on its own, but too many warnings can confuse users and reduce the actual effectiveness of every single warning, thereby increasing the overall residual risk. This echoes the problem of "over-reliance on labeling" in Clause 7.6.

blocks.zh: 實務提醒：記錄評估理由
blocks.en: Practical reminder: document the rationale

blocks.zh: ISO 14971:2019 要求將整體殘餘風險評估結果記入風險管理文件（risk management file），且強烈建議附上接受理由（rationale）。稽查時，「整體殘餘風險可接受」這個結論必須有具體理由支撐，而不是一句「所有個別風險均已評估為可接受」。
blocks.en: ISO 14971:2019 requires the result of the overall residual risk evaluation to be recorded in the risk management file, and strongly recommends attaching the rationale for acceptance. In an audit, the conclusion that "the overall residual risk is acceptable" must be supported by a concrete rationale, not just the statement "all individual risks have been evaluated as acceptable."

blocks.zh: 第9節 — 風險管理審查
blocks.en: Clause 9 - Risk Management Review

blocks.zh: 上市前的最後把關
blocks.en: The final checkpoint before release to market

blocks.zh: 風險管理審查在所有風險控制措施均實施完畢之後、商業放行之前進行。這是一個里程碑式的審查，確認：
blocks.en: The risk management review is performed after all risk control measures have been implemented and before commercial release. This is a milestone review that confirms:

blocks.zh: 風險管理計畫（risk management plan）已被正確執行
blocks.en: The risk management plan has been properly executed

blocks.zh: 整體殘餘風險可接受
blocks.en: The overall residual risk is acceptable

blocks.zh: 上市後資訊收集機制已就位
blocks.en: Methods for collecting post-production information are in place

blocks.zh: 兩種審查，不要混淆
blocks.en: Two kinds of review; do not confuse them

blocks.zh: ISO/TR 24971 特別澄清：
blocks.en: ISO/TR 24971 specifically clarifies:

blocks.zh: 風險管理計畫執行審查（Clause 9）：針對特定器材（或器材家族）的風險管理計畫執行情況進行審查。
blocks.en: Review of execution of the risk management plan (Clause 9): Reviews how the risk management plan has been executed for a specific device (or device family).

blocks.zh: 管理階層審查（Clause 4.2.3）：由最高管理層定期審查整個風險管理流程是否持續有效——屬於QMS層面的審查。
blocks.en: Management review (Clause 4.2.3): Top management periodically reviews whether the entire risk management process remains effective; this is a QMS-level review.

blocks.zh: 兩者目的不同，不能相互取代。
blocks.en: The two have different purposes and cannot replace each other.

blocks.zh: 觸發式審查：CDMO 變更控制的直接銜接
blocks.en: Triggered review: a direct link to CDMO change control

blocks.zh: 以下事件必須觸發（trigger）風險管理審查：
blocks.en: The following events must trigger a risk management review:

blocks.zh: 設計變更（design change）
blocks.en: Design change

blocks.zh: 製造流程變更（process change）
blocks.en: Manufacturing process change

blocks.zh: 上市後數據發現新問題（post-market signal）
blocks.en: New issues found in post-market data (post-market signal)

blocks.zh: 投訴趨勢（complaint trends）
blocks.en: Complaint trends

blocks.zh: 近似事件（near-miss events）
blocks.en: Near-miss events

blocks.zh: CDMO 的變更控制（Change Control）記錄應直接連結到風險管理審查的觸發記錄——任何影響產品品質的製造變更都必須評估其對風險管理的影響。
blocks.en: The CDMO's change control records should be directly linked to the triggering records for the risk management review: any manufacturing change affecting product quality must be assessed for its impact on risk management.

blocks.zh: 第10節 — 生產與上市後活動
blocks.en: Clause 10 - Production and Post-Production Activities

blocks.zh: 為何 Section 10 是整個風險管理的閉環關鍵？
blocks.en: Why is Clause 10 the key to closing the loop of risk management?

blocks.zh: ISO 14971 把風險管理定義為產品生命週期全程（life cycle）的活動，而不僅僅是設計階段的一次性工作。Section 10 就是閉環的機制：上市後收集的真實世界數據，必須反饋回到 Clauses 5–7（風險分析、評估、控制），形成持續改善的循環。
blocks.en: ISO 14971 defines risk management as an activity across the entire product life cycle, not a one-time task in the design phase. Clause 10 is the closed-loop mechanism: real-world data collected after release must be fed back into Clauses 5-7 (risk analysis, evaluation, control), forming a cycle of continual improvement.

blocks.zh: 上市後監控的主要資訊管道
blocks.en: Main information channels for post-market monitoring

blocks.zh: 投訴處理（Complaint Handling）：使用者回饋的問題，按嚴重度、器材家族、客戶類型分類分析。
blocks.en: Complaint Handling: Problems reported by users, analyzed by severity, device family and customer type.

blocks.zh: 不良事件報告（Vigilance Reports）：法規層面的強制通報，含類似器材的公開資料。
blocks.en: Vigilance Reports: Mandatory regulatory reporting, including publicly available data on similar devices.

blocks.zh: 上市後臨床追蹤（PMCF）：上市後設計的臨床研究，強化安全性與性能的臨床證據。
blocks.en: Post-Market Clinical Follow-up (PMCF): Clinical studies designed for the post-market phase to strengthen clinical evidence of safety and performance.

blocks.zh: 上市後監控（PMS）系統：主動收集所有相關資訊的系統化框架（參照 ISO/TR 20416）。
blocks.en: Post-Market Surveillance (PMS) system: A systematic framework that proactively collects all relevant information (see ISO/TR 20416).

blocks.zh: CDMO 的 APR/PQR 就是 Section 10 的核心輸入
blocks.en: The CDMO's APR/PQR is a core input to Clause 10

blocks.zh: 年度產品品質審查（Annual Product Review / Product Quality Review）是 CDMO 對製造商履行 Section 10 義務最重要的貢獻之一：
blocks.en: The Annual Product Review / Product Quality Review is one of the most important contributions a CDMO makes to the manufacturer's Clause 10 obligations:

blocks.zh: 製程監控數據（IPC 趨勢、偏差率）
blocks.en: Process monitoring data (IPC trends, deviation rates)

blocks.zh: 無菌測試結果（sterility test results）
blocks.en: Sterility test results

blocks.zh: 環境監控數據（Environmental Monitoring, EM）
blocks.en: Environmental Monitoring (EM) data

blocks.zh: 在製品（in-process）測試結果統計
blocks.en: Statistics of in-process test results

blocks.zh: 供應商績效評估
blocks.en: Supplier performance evaluation

blocks.zh: 這些數據若顯示製程品質下降，必須評估其對風險管理的影響，並觸發必要的更新。
blocks.en: If these data show a decline in process quality, the impact on risk management must be evaluated and any necessary updates triggered.

blocks.zh: 10.3 資訊審查的核心問題
blocks.en: 10.3 Core Questions in Information Review

blocks.zh: 在審查上市後資訊時，最關鍵的三個問題是：
blocks.en: When reviewing post-production information, the three most critical questions are:

blocks.zh: 我們對危害的識別是否仍然完整、正確？
blocks.en: Is our identification of hazards still complete and correct?

blocks.zh: 我們對風險機率和嚴重度的估計是否仍然準確？
blocks.en: Are our estimates of the probability and severity of risk still accurate?

blocks.zh: 我們的風險控制措施在真實世界中是否仍然有效？
blocks.en: Are our risk control measures still effective in the real world?

blocks.zh: 任何一個問題的答案從「是」變成「否」，都需要採取後續行動。
blocks.en: If the answer to any one of these questions changes from "yes" to "no," follow-up action is needed.

blocks.zh: 10.4 三類已製造器材的處置策略
blocks.en: 10.4 Handling Strategies for Three Categories of Manufactured Devices

blocks.zh: 一旦確認問題，必須分別處理三種不同狀態的器材：
blocks.en: Once a problem is confirmed, three differently situated groups of devices must be handled separately:

blocks.zh: 已在市場流通：考慮召回（recall）、Field Safety Corrective Action（FSCA）、發布安全性通知（advisory notice）。
blocks.en: Already on the market: Consider a recall, Field Safety Corrective Action (FSCA), or issuing an advisory notice.

blocks.zh: 已製造未上市（在倉庫中）：隔離並評估是否需要返工或銷毀（containment）。
blocks.en: Manufactured but not yet released (in the warehouse): Quarantine them and assess whether rework or destruction is needed (containment).

blocks.zh: 尚未製造：修改設計或製程，防止問題繼續發生。
blocks.en: Not yet manufactured: Modify the design or process to prevent the problem from continuing.

blocks.zh: Section 10 行動決策流程圖
blocks.en: Clause 10 action decision flowchart

blocks.zh: 收集上市後資訊（生產數據、投訴、文獻、PMCF）
blocks.en: Collect post-production information (production data, complaints, literature, PMCF)

blocks.zh: 審查資訊是否與安全相關
blocks.en: Review whether the information is safety-related

blocks.zh: 若相關：評估對現有風險評估和控制措施的影響
blocks.en: If relevant: evaluate the impact on the existing risk evaluation and control measures

blocks.zh: 若風險已不可接受：重回 Clauses 5–7，更新風險管理文件
blocks.en: If the risk is no longer acceptable: return to Clauses 5-7 and update the risk management file

blocks.zh: 處理三種狀態的已製造器材（已上市 / 在庫 / 待製）
blocks.en: Handle the three categories of manufactured devices (on the market / in stock / yet to be made)

blocks.zh: 將評估結果回報最高管理層，輸入 QMS 管理審查（Clause 4.2.3）
blocks.en: Report the assessment results to top management as input to the QMS management review (Clause 4.2.3)

blocks.zh: 總結：Section 6–10 的系統邏輯
blocks.en: Summary: The Systemic Logic of Clauses 6-10

blocks.zh: 風險管理不是一次性審核，是持續循環
blocks.en: Risk management is not a one-time audit; it is a continuous cycle

blocks.zh: ISO 14971 的設計邏輯是：從設計到上市後的整個生命週期，風險管理必須持續運作。Section 6–10 的連鎖關係如下：
blocks.en: The design logic of ISO 14971 is that risk management must remain active throughout the entire life cycle, from design to post-production. The chain of relationships among Clauses 6-10 is as follows:

blocks.zh: Section 6：評估——符合標準嗎？
blocks.en: Clause 6: Evaluate: does the risk meet the criteria?

blocks.zh: Section 7：不符合就控制——用正確的優先順序。
blocks.en: Clause 7: If not, control it, using the correct order of priority.

blocks.zh: Section 8：控制後再看整體——不能只看個別。
blocks.en: Clause 8: After control, look at the whole picture; you cannot look only at individual risks.

blocks.zh: Section 9：上市前最後審查——確認所有環節都做了。
blocks.en: Clause 9: Final pre-release review: confirm that every step has been done.

blocks.zh: Section 10：上市後持續監控——閉環回到前面各節。
blocks.en: Clause 10: Continuous post-production monitoring, closing the loop back to the earlier clauses.

blocks.zh: CDMO 角色定位
blocks.en: CDMO Role Positioning

blocks.zh: 作為製造服務提供商，CDMO 的主要貢獻集中在：
blocks.en: As a manufacturing service provider, the CDMO's main contributions are concentrated in:

blocks.zh: Section 7.1.2：製造過程的風險控制（IPC、EM、滅菌驗證）
blocks.en: Clause 7.1.2: Risk control of manufacturing processes (IPC, EM, sterilization validation)

blocks.zh: Section 9：變更控制觸發審查
blocks.en: Clause 9: Change control triggering review

blocks.zh: Section 10：APR/PQR 提供上市後製造數據
blocks.en: Clause 10: APR/PQR providing post-market manufacturing data

blocks.zh: 器材製造商（MAH/NDA holder）負責整體風險管理決策，CDMO 負責提供製造層面的可靠數據輸入，讓製造商能做出正確判斷。
blocks.en: The device manufacturer (MAH/NDA holder) is responsible for the overall risk management decisions, while the CDMO is responsible for providing reliable manufacturing-level data inputs so that the manufacturer can make correct judgments.
